title: Codify reviewed learning in its owning artifacts

spec.description: Separate authoritative Git state, learned memory, session work and observed evidence. Use Observe -> Evaluate -> Learn -> Hypothesize -> Propose -> Prove -> Review -> Codify. Preserve consequential rationale in decisions and change the root-cause artifact through review; evidence never silently rewrites intent. Use Git and review history instead of parallel change/learning registries.
